how_to_apply: Fill in the prescribed application form: Annexure I (PDF/Research Associate), Annexure II (Research Assistant) or Annexure III (Lab Technician).
Sign the form and attach one set of self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications (10th onwards), experience, publications, valid ID proof and other relevant documents.
Superscribe the envelope 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ......' with Advt. No. and Date.
Send it by Speed Post only to the Nodal Officer, CoE in SMAT, PG Department of Chemistry, Fakir Mohan University, Vyasa Vihar, Baleshwar-756089, Odisha.
The application must reach on or before 18/11/2026 (by 5:00 PM).
Also email a single PDF file of the complete filled-in application form to [email protected].
